summary: Frontend-only verification of the shared Sheet component via /_sheettest harness on mobile viewport (390x844). Validated open, close via X button (testID=sheet-close), close via backdrop tap (testID=sheet-scrim), close via primary action (testID=t-add), reopenability after each close, visible dimmed scrim (rgba(16,16,16,0.45), opacity=1), and absence of leftover overlay. All four acceptance criteria in the bug fix request pass on web. Swipe-down-to-dismiss could not be fully exercised through Playwright mouse-drag (PanResponder requires real touch gesture semantics on web); the gesture handler code is present and the fix was primarily targeted at iOS native, which the harness is not able to run. Code review of /app/frontend/src/components/sheets.tsx looks clean: core Animated (not Reanimated) inside RN <Modal>, proper mount/unmount via `rendered` state, scrim Pressable has testID, close button has testID, swipe handler releases on dy>120 or vy>0.8. No deprecated expo packages were introduced in this file.
action_items: Swipe-to-dismiss gesture should be validated on an actual iOS device/simulator (Expo Go) since Playwright mouse drag on web does not reliably trigger PanResponder; code path looks correct but needs native verification by main agent / user.

Benign console warning on web: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported ... Falling back to JS-based animation'. Behavior is correct on web; on native iOS the native driver will engage. No change required unless main agent wants to silence the warning on web.
critical_code_review_comments: Sheet uses core Animated + PanResponder inside <Modal> — matches the stated fix for iOS Reanimated-in-Modal issue.
Scrim is a full-screen absoluteFill Animated.View with Pressable child using testID='sheet-scrim' and onPress=onClose — tap-anywhere-above-sheet works.
Close X button is a Pressable with testID='sheet-close', hitSlop=10, correctly positioned (top-right, zIndex=2).
`rendered` state ensures component unmounts after exit animation completes, so no leftover overlay blocks underlying interactions. Confirmed by successive reopen test.
KeyboardAvoidingView wraps the sheet — good for iOS keyboard behavior.
ConfirmSheet reuses the shared Sheet component — fix propagates automatically to all usages.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (6/6 required behaviors verified on web; swipe gesture pending native verification)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Harness route /_sheettest renders the shared Sheet with testIDs: open-sheet, sheet-close, sheet-scrim, t-item, t-add. All work on web preview with mobile viewport. Swipe-down-to-dismiss requires native iOS verification (Playwright mouse drag cannot simulate PanResponder gestures reliably). Login flow is still blocked by Supabase email confirmation setting, so real Grocery/Home sheets cannot be reached — use the harness.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: Reanimated animated styles were not committed inside RN <Modal> on iOS, so the scrim appeared transparent and un-tappable, trapping the sheet open. Applied fix (verified on web): replaced Reanimated with React Native core Animated.Value + Animated.timing/spring, added an explicit visible close (X) button, kept backdrop Pressable, and added PanResponder-based swipe-down dismissal on the handle. Scrim backgroundColor rgba(16,16,16,0.45) with animated opacity 0→1 is now visible (verified: parentOpacity=1, backgroundColor=rgba(16,16,16,0.45)). Reopen cycle works repeatedly, confirming unmount via `rendered` state.
